summary: Phase 1 frontend-only testing for TrailVista Expeditions. Executed 43 Playwright checks against the public preview URL covering hero rendering, navbar/dropdowns/theme toggle, all 15 routes (13 unique pages + dynamic trek/destinations/categories), TrekDetail sticky booking layout, EnquiryModal end-to-end submission with success state, Contact form submission, AllTreks/Gallery/Departures filters, Footer + newsletter, mobile menu open/close, and theme persistence across navigation. 43/43 passed, 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: TrekDetail.js 'Book Now' button (data-testid=trek-detail-book-now) has no onClick handler - currently a no-op. Either wire it to scroll-to-form, open EnquiryModal, or future booking flow.
EnquiryModal hardcodes travel-month options (Feb-Jul 2026). Consider deriving from data or using a date input for longer-term maintainability.
Navbar dropdowns rely on onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave only - not keyboard or touch accessible. Consider click-to-toggle + ARIA expanded.
CinematicHero word3 first letter highlight assumes 3+ letter word (uses word3.slice(1)). Defensive coding for shorter words would be safer.

Hero CTA buttons in CinematicHero rely on onPrimaryClick/onSecondaryClick props but Home.js usage should be verified to ensure both are wired (could not find issues in run, but worth a quick code review).
seed_data_creation: None - all data is local dummy data from /app/frontend/src/data/treksData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 acceptance items verified passing on https://expedition-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Theme toggle persists via localStorage key 'trailvista-theme'. Hero confirmed with layered CLIMB / BEYOND (outline) / LIMITS (glacier-blue L) on mountain background. TrekDetail booking sidebar correctly uses 2-col grid for WhatsApp+Brochure (no giant green block). Enquiry modal success state works (2s auto-close). Contact form 5 fields - submits and shows success message. All 13 routes + dynamic trek/destination/category routes render. Mobile menu hamburger open/close works at 390x844. No console errors observed.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
